en.quote: And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
en.riddle: that no more of thy name be sown
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וְצִוָּה עָלֶיךָ יְהוָה לֹא-יִזָּרַע מִשִּׁמְךָ עוֹד מִבֵּית אֱלֹהֶיךָ אַכְרִית פֶּסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה אָשִׂים קִבְרֶךָ כִּי קַלּֽוֹתָ
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
